correctness.rationale: Exact recolour energy difference is exterior count of target minus source colour. Full three-colour support in a part forces three equal integers summing to 2n and hence 3|n. When 3 does not divide n, any exclusive colour forces its containing part monochromatic; the other parts are either properly opposite monochromes or each split equally. With no exclusive colour the 3x3 incidence support is the complement of a permutation, and equal exterior minima force every present colour count to n/2. The resulting six proper, nine half-half-pair and six cyclic-half-half support types yield the stated finite energy polynomial with correct multinomial multiplicities. When 3|n the fully balanced family and trivial upper bound yield the asserted logarithmic limit by Stirling. A separate raw-spin energy checker verified n=1,2,3 and exhaustive weighted-matrix checks verified n=1..12; finite tests supplement, do not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: Single-site kinetic blocking is a natural metastability notion for an antiferromagnetic Potts Hamiltonian. The first frustrated balanced complete multipartite graph has drastically different numbers and energies of kinetic traps according to the arithmetic of its part size. The theorem gives a complete nontriple-size energy-resolved census and exactly three distinct limiting entropy rates (0, log 2, log 3), including infinitely many sizes with only six ground-state traps; this is a structural phenomenon not a renamed textbook estimate.
